_doc: Ban dich EN cho catalog Store (fork Thansa). Catalog upstream (javis-store) chi co mo ta 'vi'; packs_store.py._them_en chen ban 'en' nay vao map name/description de packs.js nn() hien English. Cap nhat khi catalog upstream them goi moi.

javis.tinh-gia.name: Pricing helper
javis.tinh-gia.desc: Turn cost into a shelf price: margin or markup, VAT, rounded up to a tidy number. Reports the real margin after rounding.

javis.khach-hang-crm.name: Customer management (CRM)
javis.khach-hang-crm.desc: A customer book on top of the Conversations page: customers from Telegram, Zalo Bot and personal Zalo; per-person profile and history, tags, notes, unanswered queue, stats, Excel export. Ships a support agent and a daily review workflow. Needs Thansa 0.60.1 or newer.

javis.composio.name: Composio
javis.composio.desc: Composio's multi-app gateway: one connection opens 500+ apps (Gmail, Notion, Google Sheets, GitHub, Linear, Slack...). Thansa finds the tool, links each app's account and runs actions through Composio, so Thansa doesn't have to write a custom connector for every app. Paste an API key (ck_...) and you're done.

javis.pancake-pos.name: Pancake POS
javis.pancake-pos.desc: Orders, revenue, customers, inventory and ads from Pancake POS. One API key per store - add multiple accounts for multiple shops.

javis.shopify.name: Shopify
javis.shopify.desc: Look up products, prices and stock and pre-build a cart for ONE Shopify store via the official MCP (UCP standard). No API key, no app install, no need to own the shop - just the store address.

javis.webcake-landing.name: Webcake Landing
javis.webcake-landing.desc: Let the AI design and edit Webcake landing pages by voice (create pages, edit sections, publish...). Runs locally via npx, one JWT per account.

javis.webcake-landing-web.name: Webcake Landing (web login)
javis.webcake-landing-web.desc: The same Webcake landing toolkit but running on a hosted server: click Connect and log in - no JWT to paste, no Node.js on your machine.

javis.google-sheets.name: Google Sheets
javis.google-sheets.desc: Read and write Google spreadsheets: push revenue, inventory and receivables reports to Sheets automatically. Connects with a service account - no login needed.

javis.google-search-console.name: Google Search Console
javis.google-search-console.desc: Website SEO metrics: which keywords bring visitors to your pages, plus impressions, clicks and top pages.

javis.google-workspace.name: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs)
javis.google-workspace.desc: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, Tasks... in ONE connection. Create an OAuth client once, about 10 minutes, with step-by-step instructions. The first time you call a Google tool, a browser opens ON THE MACHINE RUNNING THANSA for you to approve, so that machine needs a display.

javis.google-tasks.name: Google Tasks
javis.google-tasks.desc: Your to-dos in Google Tasks: view lists, add tasks, set due dates, mark them done. Asks only for Tasks permission - never touches Gmail or Drive. Sign in to Google with your own OAuth client (~10 minutes, guided).

javis.meta-ads.name: Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
javis.meta-ads.desc: Facebook/Instagram ad metrics via Meta's official MCP (ad accounts, campaign performance, industry benchmarks, product catalog). NOTE: this is Meta's LIMITED beta - only a few apps pre-approved by Meta can connect; self-serve connection is NOT yet available.

javis.meta-ads-graph.name: Meta Ads (bring your own app - Graph API)
javis.meta-ads-graph.desc: Facebook/Instagram ad metrics calling Meta's Marketing API DIRECTLY (NOT through the locked MCP beta). You create one Facebook App, paste the App ID + App Secret, and Thansa reads your ad accounts, campaigns and performance. READ-ONLY - it never creates or edits campaigns and never spends money. This is how platforms like Composio do it.

javis.facebook-pages.name: Facebook Pages (bring your own app - Graph API)
javis.facebook-pages.desc: Manage your Facebook Pages via the official Graph API: list Pages, read posts and comments (read-only), post text, PHOTOS, multi-photo ALBUMS and VIDEO, EDIT published posts and reply to comments (full access). You create one Facebook App (you can reuse the one you already have for Meta Ads), then paste the App ID + App Secret. Posting and editing are REAL actions, so they only run at full-access level, never silently.

javis.facebook-monitor.name: Facebook monitoring (Apify)
javis.facebook-monitor.desc: Monitor PUBLIC Facebook Pages and Groups to find viral posts (lots of shares), through the Apify scraping service. It does NOT use your personal account, so there's no ban risk; runs fine on a VPS 24/7. Returns posts with share/react/comment counts so you can filter the hot ones. Needs an Apify token (free signup, pay per scrape ~2.6 USD per 1000 posts). PRIVATE groups come later (need an extra cookie).

javis.google-ads.name: Google Ads
javis.google-ads.desc: Google Ads metrics via Google's official MCP (read-only): campaigns, spend, conversions and keywords through GAQL queries. Runs locally; needs a developer token + Google Cloud, a somewhat technical one-time setup.

javis.tiktok-ads.name: TikTok Ads
javis.tiktok-ads.desc: TikTok ad metrics (read-only): accounts, campaigns, ad groups, creatives, performance reports. A community server running locally on the official Marketing API - paste App ID + Secret + Access Token.

javis.google-calendar.name: Google Calendar
javis.google-calendar.desc: Google Calendar via Google's official MCP: view your calendar, find free slots, create and edit events, set reminders. Sign in to Google in the dashboard; works on a VPS too. Needs a one-time OAuth client + Google Developer Preview enrollment (~10 minutes).

javis.gmail.name: Gmail
javis.gmail.desc: Gmail via Google's official MCP: read and search mail, compose DRAFTS, apply labels to organize your inbox. The official server has NO direct-send tool - it always stops at a draft for you to send yourself. Needs a one-time OAuth client + Google Developer Preview enrollment.

javis.slack.name: Slack
javis.slack.desc: Search, read and send Slack messages, view channels and members, and manage canvases via Slack's official MCP. You need to create a Slack app in the workspace and get admin approval (this is Slack's mandatory requirement).

javis.systeme-io.name: Systeme.io
javis.systeme-io.desc: Manage contacts, tags, custom fields, newsletters and funnels in Systeme.io via the official MCP. Just paste the MCP key (keys last up to 90 days, max 2 keys per account).

javis.lark.name: Lark
javis.lark.desc: Messaging, Docs, Base/Bitable data tables, wiki and contacts in Lark via the official MCP. Runs locally with your own app (paste App ID + App Secret). You need to create a Lark app and grant the matching permissions.

javis.higgsfield.name: Higgsfield
javis.higgsfield.desc: Create and edit images and video with Higgsfield's AI via the official MCP: generate images, generate video, upscale, expand the frame, remove backgrounds, cut out subjects, control motion. One-tap Higgsfield login - no app to create, no key to paste. Note: each generation or edit spends your Higgsfield credits.

javis.x-twitter.name: X (Twitter)
javis.x-twitter.desc: Search and read posts, view public profiles and metrics on X (Twitter) via X's official MCP. Paste an App-only Bearer Token from the X Developer Portal - used for reading and searching; posting needs user OAuth (to be added if needed).

javis.google-keep.name: Google Keep
javis.google-keep.desc: Read and edit Google Keep notes: find notes, create notes and to-do lists, add labels, pin and archive. NOTE: Keep has no official API, so it needs a master token with FULL access to your Google account, not scope-limited OAuth like Gmail or Calendar. Thansa only touches notes, but the token opens the whole account if leaked.

javis.notebooklm.name: Google NotebookLM
javis.notebooklm.desc: Read and work with notebooks on Google NotebookLM: list notebooks, read sources, ask questions right inside a notebook, add sources, save notes, create summaries/audio in Studio. NOTE: NotebookLM has no official API yet, so it borrows your BROWSER SESSION (Google cookie), not scope-limited OAuth like Gmail or Calendar.

javis.n8n.name: n8n
javis.n8n.desc: Control your n8n: find and read workflows, view run history, create and edit workflows, and run them - via n8n's official MCP. Needs your n8n address + an MCP Access Token.

javis.hostinger.name: Hostinger
javis.hostinger.desc: Manage Hostinger hosting right in chat: view domains and expiry dates, edit DNS records, view websites and WordPress, VPS, mailboxes, invoices and active plans. Hostinger's official MCP - just paste an API token.

javis.hermes-creative.name: Hermes: Creative & design
javis.hermes-creative.desc: 10 creative skills from Hermes Agent: SVG architecture diagrams, infographics, HTML artifacts, Manim videos, p5.js sketches, 54 real design systems, Suno song prompts, and an AI-slop remover.

javis.hermes-office.name: Hermes: Office documents
javis.hermes-office.desc: 6 document skills from Hermes Agent: Word .docx, Excel .xlsx, PowerPoint .pptx, PDF (create, merge, OCR, fill), plus two skills that extract cited action items from documents and meeting notes.

javis.hermes-productivity.name: Hermes: Productivity tools
javis.hermes-productivity.desc: 8 productivity skills from Hermes Agent: Airtable, Box, Notion, Obsidian, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, OpenStreetMap routing, and a weekly review routine.

javis.hermes-research.name: Hermes: Research & monitoring
javis.hermes-research.desc: 5 research skills from Hermes Agent: arXiv search, competitor news monitoring, price watching, a Karpathy-style LLM wiki, and grounding every answer in verifiable citations.

javis.hermes-dev.name: Hermes: Dev workflow
javis.hermes-dev.desc: 8 engineering-workflow skills from Hermes Agent: GitHub via gh CLI, RED-GREEN-REFACTOR TDD, 4-phase root-cause debugging, pre-commit review, code cleanup, spikes, codebase sizing, and Kanban handoffs.

javis.hermes-debug.name: Hermes: Debugging & QA
javis.hermes-debug.desc: 3 debugging skills from Hermes Agent: Node.js via --inspect and the Chrome DevTools Protocol, Python via pdb + debugpy (DAP), and exploratory QA of web apps with evidence-backed bug reports.

javis.hermes-media.name: Hermes: Audio & video
javis.hermes-media.desc: 3 media skills from Hermes Agent: turn YouTube transcripts into summaries, threads and blogs; search and download GIFs from Tenor; and analyse audio spectrograms (mel, chroma, MFCC).

javis.hermes-apple.name: Hermes: Apple (macOS only)
javis.hermes-apple.desc: 4 Apple skills from Hermes Agent: Notes, Reminders, Find My and iMessage/SMS. macOS ONLY - each one needs its own CLI installed on the machine (memo, remindctl, imsg).

javis.hermes-ai-agents.name: Hermes: AI agent orchestration
javis.hermes-ai-agents.desc: 7 Hermes Agent skills for delegating to other agents: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode, computer use, plus three about Hermes Agent itself (config, skill authoring, desktop DOM inspection).

javis.hermes-inbox-web.name: Hermes: Inbox & web
javis.hermes-inbox-web.desc: 4 inbox and web skills from Hermes Agent: triage an inbox and draft replies safely, IMAP/SMTP mail via the Himalaya CLI, X/Twitter via xurl, and recovering pages blocked by 403/429, paywalls or WAFs.

javis.anthropic-plugin-dev.name: Claude: Plugin development
javis.anthropic-plugin-dev.desc: Anthropic's 7 official skills for building Claude Code plugins: plugin structure, slash commands, subagents, hooks, MCP integration, user-configurable settings, and writing SKILL.md files.

javis.anthropic-mcp-dev.name: Claude: MCP server development
javis.anthropic-mcp-dev.desc: Anthropic's 3 official skills for MCP servers: wrap an API into a server (tools, resources, transports, testing), add interactive UI widgets (MCP apps), and package it as a one-click .mcpb bundle.

javis.anthropic-claude-setup.name: Claude: Setup & security
javis.anthropic-claude-setup.desc: Anthropic's 5 official skills for tuning Claude Code itself: create and benchmark skills, recommend automations for a codebase, audit CLAUDE.md, write hookify rules, and run security scans.

javis.anthropic-ui-report.name: Claude: UI & reports
javis.anthropic-ui-report.desc: Anthropic's 5 official skills for visible output: deliberate UI design direction, interactive HTML playgrounds, tabbed project status pages, session usage reports, and Claude Code usage receipts.

javis.anthropic-chat-channels.name: Claude: Chat channels (Discord/Telegram/iMessage)
javis.anthropic-chat-channels.desc: 6 skills from partner plugins in Anthropic's directory: set up and manage access for the Discord, Telegram and iMessage channels - approve pairings, edit allowlists, set DM/group policy.

javis.anthropic-lab.name: Claude: Math olympiad & M5 hardware
javis.anthropic-lab.desc: 3 Anthropic skills: solve olympiad problems (IMO, Putnam, USAMO) with an adversarial verifier and calibrated confidence, plus two for flashing and programming M5Stack ESP32 devices in MicroPython.

javis.deepseek-review.name: DeepSeek: Review & prose standard
javis.deepseek-review.desc: 4 reusable skills lifted from deepseek-harness: review a pull request correctness-first, an editorial standard for comments and docs, find code that can be simplified, and record a browser session as a GIF.

javis.superpowers.name: Superpowers
javis.superpowers.desc: 14 workflow skills by Jesse Vincent (obra/superpowers): brainstorm before coding, write and execute plans, TDD, systematic debugging, both sides of code review, git worktrees, and verifying before claiming done.

javis.playwright.name: Playwright
javis.playwright.desc: Drive a real browser through Microsoft's official Playwright MCP: open pages, read page structure, fill forms, click, screenshot, export PDF, run end-to-end tests. No API key. Defaults to an isolated, headless profile.

javis.quang-cao-so-lieu.name: Ads & analytics
javis.quang-cao-so-lieu.desc: 3 agents and 3 workflows for reading ad numbers: weekly Meta/Google/TikTok Ads reports, hunting for budget being burned for nothing, and a monthly Search Console read. Every number must cite its source, and the last step always has an independent verifier.

javis.noi-dung-social.name: Content & social
javis.noi-dung-social.desc: 4 agents and 3 workflows for content: turn one idea into a finished post, split a long piece into a post series, and plan a month of content. Angle-finding before writing, and an editing pass that cuts the fluff after.

javis.email-pheu.name: Email & funnel
javis.email-pheu.desc: 3 agents and 3 workflows for email marketing: a nurture sequence after a customer downloads a free lead magnet, a re-engagement sequence for a cold list, and a diagnosis of where the funnel is leaking. Writes the sequence without giving away all of your paid product's content.

javis.san-pham-ban-hang.name: Digital products & sales
javis.san-pham-ban-hang.desc: 4 agents and 3 workflows for digital products: turn skills you already have into a sellable product idea, build a sales page from a customer profile, and run a post-purchase sequence that earns testimonials. Every sales promise gets checked against whether the product can actually deliver it.

javis.tro-ly-hang-ngay.name: Everyday assistants
javis.tro-ly-hang-ngay.desc: 3 everyday agents that work standalone: a secretary who clears the inbox and orders the day's tasks, a summariser who turns long documents into decisions and action items, and a devil's advocate who finds the holes in a plan before you commit to it.

javis.tro-ly-nghien-cuu.name: Research & language assistants
javis.tro-ly-nghien-cuu.desc: 3 agents for learning and multilingual writing: a researcher who answers with citations and files findings into the Second Brain, a translator who localises Vietnamese-English marketing copy without losing its selling power, and an explainer who unpacks a hard concept before you rely on it.

javis.tts-dropship.name: TTS Dropship (thitruongsi.com)
javis.tts-dropship.desc: Sell dropship on the TTS marketplace: find products by profit, extract addresses from customer messages, create customers, quote shipping, PLACE ORDERS, track shipments and see money coming in. The marketplace issues no API key, so you log in with a token pulled from the browser. If the marketplace changes its data shape, the pack inspects the schema ITSELF and rewrites its queries - no reinstall. Placing and cancelling orders always require two-step confirmation.
